blocks.text: Indicative labour per m² of floor area, three levels of scope.

blocks.alt: Empty flat under renovation: doors wrapped in film, materials on the floor

blocks.text: “From” rates cover labour per m² of the flat’s floor area. The light level includes priming and painting walls and ceilings. Medium may also cover skim coating, floors, doors and fittings; heavy may cover strip-out, tiling and agreed service alterations. These are indicative levels, not unlimited packages: before starting, we record areas, door and service-point quantities and exclusions. Materials and parts are separate. Do not add items already included in the agreed scope.

items: Light level: priming and painting walls and ceilings
Medium: skim coat across the walls, floor, doors, skirting, fittings
Heavy: strip-out, tiling, reworked wiring and plumbing, sanitaryware
Indicative labour per m² of floor area; quantities, scope and price confirmed after inspection

blocks.text: An initial estimate from a description, photos or video is free. A call-out with basic diagnostics costs 246 zł even without a repair; if work proceeds, this amount is included in its price. Extended electrical fault location is priced separately, from 350 zł. The minimum visit is 246 zł; cleaning has a 250 zł minimum and minimum hours. Travel tops labour up to the minimum; chargeable out-of-town mileage is extra. Unlisted repairs: 199 zł/h. Moving: minimum 2 hours, with the first 80 km of the agreed route included in the van rate. Materials are agreed separately.

blocks.text: Describe the problem, get a price
Write on WhatsApp or call: a photo and one sentence are enough for a price. Or price the whole job yourself — in the calculator on the home page.
